peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 10.3% below its local comparables; 41 of 130 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (99.2): 8.3 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 390 of 393 similar developments with a figure. Context, not scored: resales in 29.2% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 1-bedroom: median $618,000 ($1,552 psf, 398 sq ft; 5 resales, Jan 2024–Dec 2025); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,731 psf (range $1,453–1,940); 10.3% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $71,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Aljunied MRT about 480 m, Mountbatten MRT about 760 m; closer than 352 of 662 similar developments (the same as 14). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 4 within 2 km; nearest Geylang Methodist School (Primary) about 690 m; more than 292 of 662 similar developments (the same as 254). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 11 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 60 m), more than 513 of 662 similar developments (the same as 79); nearest hawker centre Sims Vista Market And Food Centre about 460 m; nearest park Kallang Riverside Park about 1,100 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Sims Vista Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 5 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Zyanya, 2 new sales, about 400 m; Grand Dunman, 72 new sales, about 1,360 m; Arina East Residences, 85 new sales, about 1,560 m; The Continuum, 208 new sales, about 1,730 m; Aurea, 39 new sales, about 1,900 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 225 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 406 new sales and 587 resales (993 purchases); new sales were 40.9% of these purchases. Subsales (53) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Kallang Close GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,310 m; Tanjong Rhu Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,750 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 587 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 160 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 587 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 720 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−18.5%). Planning-area private resales −17.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
